responsibility: Render memory search query input, loading/empty/error states, balanced-canvas results with feedback buttons, and low-confidence banner (US-RET-001/006, US-FBK-001/003, US-SRC-005)

inputs.displayableResults: Policy-allowed results with source-resolvable content, stable memoryId/Focus route and real aspect ratio or summary
inputs.presentationKind: Per-result deterministic UI-only mapping: scanEligible for source-resolvable photo/video or an independently meaningful trimmed summary of 1...160 Swift Character grapheme clusters; continuousReading for longer or continuous-reading note, voice transcript or body text

outputs.visibleContent: Search result cards with title, source, time, similarity
outputs.accessibilityTree: Cards as combined accessibility elements with type/description/time

fallbackConditions: Available width cannot fit two 152pt cards plus gutter
scanEligible does not strictly outnumber continuousReading (ties use single column)
Critical media cannot be safely cropped
orderingRule: Masonry preserves SearchPipeline relevance order, partial/low-confidence semantics and feedback memoryId binding
gestureRule: Generic search result cards have no horizontal swipe; feedback and problem reporting use explicit controls, menus and accessibility actions
